scope.description: An optional still-life direction for one user-specified object. Combine two or three useful views of that same object—such as side, front, or top—inside one connected faceted form. Preserve enough silhouette and object clues for recognition; keep the surrounding table and background shallow and quieter so the viewpoint shift stays local. limitations: Activate only for a user-requested single object suitable for a still-life study.

rules.applies_when: The user requests one still-life object and allows interpretive viewpoints.
rules.instruction: Show two or three distinct useful views of the same object within one connected silhouette; shift the angle at selected facets rather than repeating the object as separate copies.
rules.observable: The object remains countable as one and at least two viewpoints can be read in its planes or opening while the overall silhouette remains recognizable.
rules.reject_when: The object is duplicated, the views cannot be distinguished, or facet breaks make the object unidentifiable.
rules.avoid: shattered-glass fragmentation, random polygon overlay, and copied named object layout

rules.applies_when: The user requests a recognizable everyday object.
rules.instruction: Preserve two or more identity-critical cues from the requested object—such as handle, spout, opening, rim, or base—across the facet transitions; do not alter its material or function.
rules.observable: A viewer can name the object from its connected outer contour and stable cues even though its views are not optically consistent.
rules.reject_when: Identity depends on a label, a second duplicate, or a copied reference composition.
rules.avoid: added text, extra object copies, and unrequested collage labels

rules.applies_when: The brief permits a sparse tabletop or neutral setting.
rules.instruction: Keep the supporting table and background in broad shallow planes with fewer viewpoint shifts and lower detail than the main object.
rules.observable: The eye first reads the single transformed object, then the support plane; surrounding geometry does not compete with its viewpoint changes.
rules.reject_when: Every background plane fractures as strongly as the main form or the requested setting disappears.
rules.avoid: dense all-over fragmentation and deep photographic perspective
